description:
Cast Silver Myr by paying {2}.
Silver Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Replication Specialist, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Silver Myr.
Activate both Silver Myr by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Myr Galvanizer by paying {3}.
Myr Galvanizer enters the battlefield, triggering Replication Specialist, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Myr Galvanizer.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Activate both Silver Myr by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 6.
